title: Common-covariance Gaussian missing information is a posterior MMSE

mmse_control.hypothesis: X_N=M_N+G_N with square-integrable M_N, independent G_N~N(0,S_N), and one common stationary diagonal S_N in a fixed relative K1572 profile band.
mmse_control.identity: D_N=E[(A_N-E[A_N|A_N+Z_N])^T B_N(A_N-E[A_N|A_N+Z_N])] is exactly the K1606 missing Fisher information; the mixture-energy gain is D_N/4.
mmse_control.i_mmse: For Y_t=sqrt(t)A_N+Z_N, I(A_N;Y_1)=(1/2)int_0^1 mmse(A_N|Y_t)dt and monotonicity gives mmse(A_N|A_N+Z_N)<=2I(A_N;A_N+Z_N).
mmse_control.scope_guard: One common Gaussian covariance is load-bearing. The theorem does not control label-dependent covariances, non-Gaussian component shapes, phases, textures, nonstationarity, or unrestricted states.
